critical_code_review_comments: CrewSchedulePage.jsx is 658 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting SingleShiftForm + CrewBuilderModal into their own files.

PATCH /crews merges prior rotation_days_on/off values, so pattern='custom' can silently inherit values that were auto-set by a previous rotation preset. Consider forcing an explicit rotation_days payload when pattern flips to custom.

Auto-opposite crew start-date offset: opposite crew starts on start_date + on_d — this assumes both crews share the same 'start_date' string in DB but generate shifts with a runtime offset. The DB doc for the opposite crew stores the SAME start_date as crew A, so re-editing the opposite crew and re-generating won't reproduce the offset. This is a latent bug for the edit flow of the opposite crew.
